pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, soft cinematic atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
Under quiet starlight that night
your smile lit the streets of my world
a trembling warmth from your hand
still resting inside my heart

Time slowly passes by
but you remain somewhere in me

[Pre-Chorus]
In the quiet air of memory
your name drifts back again

[Chorus]
You were every moment I had
like laughter hidden in tears
Even knowing that road is closed now
my heart still turns to you

[Verse 2]
When the rain begins to fall
your face appears in the window light
under a small umbrella
a silent feeling stayed with me

Memories scatter with the wind
but your name does not fade away

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo)

[Bridge]
Longing moves like distant waves
touching the shore of my chest
I stand within the quiet years
watching where you once were

[Chorus]
You were every dream I held
even the fragile love was beautiful
Now I only see you from afar
but my heart still remembers you

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, fading gently)

If we ever meet again
I would hold you without a word
In the dark behind closed eyes
your voice is still there
